visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of metal tongs held by a male hand places thick, raw pork belly slices onto a stone-textured griddle. The meat has distinct layers of fat and lean muscle. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the grease as the meat begins to sear. (2) The tongs flip the meat strips, revealing a crispy, golden-brown charred surface. In the background, a light orange tabby cat sits on a wooden surface, staring calmly toward the camera with a neutral expression. (3) Using black kitchen shears, the man cuts the long strips into smaller square pieces. Garlic cloves are poured from a small white bowl into the rendered fat at the center of the pan. (4) Red, fermented kimchi is mounded in the middle of the griddle. The man uses tongs to spread it and stir-fry it with the garlic, creating a vibrant color contrast against the meat. (5) Three large eggs are cracked directly into the center of the bubbling kimchi, their yolks remaining whole and bright orange. (6) The man, sitting on a grey couch, uses chopsticks to dip a piece of cooked meat into a raw yolk and then wraps it in a fresh green lettuce leaf. (7) He takes a large bite, chewing with visible satisfaction and eyes closed, gesturing with his hands. (8) A sudden cut shows a group of pigs running through a snowy field, followed by a return to the man eating in his living room. (9) He stands behind a white Philips air purifier, demonstrating a side latch that opens to reveal collected pet hair inside a tray. A black and white cat sits on top of the device. (10) Red arrows and text highlight the three-way air intake on the machine. He presses a button on the top control panel to show the child lock feature. (11) He sits with a young boy and the orange cat, gesturing towards the camera as a final promotional slogan appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic pop BGM with a driving beat and bright synth melodies starts immediately. The man's voice is high-arousal and loud, speaking Traditional Chinese with fast delivery. Sharp sizzling sounds of meat hitting a hot pan are layered over the music. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX marks each time a visual text label appears. The man's tone is teasing and enthusiastic. Continuous background pop music maintains a consistent rhythmic pace. (3) Rapid 'snip' sound effects are perfectly timed with the visual cutting of meat. A clear cat 'meow' is heard, followed by a cartoon-style 'boing' effect. (4) Narration speed increases as ingredients are listed. A low-frequency thud accompanies the garlic being poured. Sizzling intensity rises during the kimchi stir-fry. (5) The sound of eggshells cracking is crisp and high-frequency. The BGM remains upbeat. A comedic 'whoosh' transition leads to a brief shift in BGM style. (6) Loud, wet crunching sounds are emphasized as the man bites into the lettuce wrap. He emits an audible 'mmm' vocalization. (7) The music transitions to a more stable, informative pop track. The man's voice becomes professional as he explains technical features. Mechanical clicks of the air purifier door opening and a soft fan whir are audible. (8) High-pitched UI beeps sound when he presses the control panel buttons. (9) A final high-energy vocal recommendation is followed by a melodic brand stinger and a final fade-out of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Evidence -> Transformation -> Problem -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a high-engagement cooking demonstration of Korean pork belly to capture the viewer's attention before pivoting to a common lifestyle concern for pet owners (hair and allergies), ultimately promoting the Philips air purifier as a specialized solution.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration with brand logo (Philips AC3681) and list of technical benefits.
